title: Putting the walls and the prizes to work
target: How to use decoration and the tournament prize shelf in TCG Card Shop Simulator so the walls and the prize display are doing a job rather than only filling space.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Some decoration to put on them
A prize shelf if you run tournaments

steps.do: Treat posters as a decoration kind of their own rather than as pictures in general.
steps.because: posters are kept in a list of their own beside other decoration (m_PosterDecoList)

steps.do: Keep wall decoration and wall-bar decoration apart when you are planning a wall.
steps.because: the two are listed separately (m_WallDecoDataList, m_WallBarDecoDataList)

steps.do: Remember that the shop billboard is its own object, not a wall slot.
steps.because: the billboard is an interactable object of its own (InteractableShopBillboard)

steps.do: Put prizes on the shelf built for them rather than on any spare rack.
steps.because: there is a shelf dedicated to tournament prizes (TournamentPrizeShelf)

steps.do: Know that a shelf's purpose is a kind of shelf, not a label you apply.
steps.because: shelves are typed, with card shelves and combination shelves among them (CardShelf, CardItemCombiShelf, Shelf)

steps.do: Fill the compartments the shelf actually has, and give it the stand points it asks for.
steps.because: the prize shelf keeps its own compartment groups, a screen mesh, and separate stand locations for customers and for winners (m_CardShelfCompartmentGrpList, m_ShelfCompartmentGrpList, m_ScreenMesh, m_CustomerStandLocList, m_WinnerStandLocList)

steps.do: Let the shelf manager track what is on the shelves instead of tracking it yourself.
steps.because: shelf contents are tracked by a manager regardless of the shelf's purpose (ShelfManager)

steps.do: Watch where a fixture cuts the walkable floor before you commit to its place.
steps.because: a shelf is marked with its object type and with whether it cuts the navmesh (m_ObjectType, m_NavMeshCut, m_IsGenericObject)

commonMistakes: Treating every wall slot as the same kind of slot.
Hanging prizes on the first rack you find instead of the prize shelf.
Filling a shelf without regard to the compartments it actually has.
Placing a fixture across the path customers walk.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
